note: The gate registry. One entry per gate; the runner and the ingest script read only this file. Phase 4 adds its rows by adding entries here and scripts under gates/; run-gates.ps1 does not change. priority: P1 runs first, then P2, then P3. group: any | interface | cold | settled | network | mic | long. needs: interface (loopback cable on the audio interface, or VB-CABLE), ac, mic, boot_within_min (cold: starts only this soon after a restart), uptime_min and idle (settled). interactive: needs a person at the keyboard. prepare: runs before everything else. quick: what -Quick does (the dry run); skipped = not run under -Quick. ledger: the rows of docs/GATES.md the result feeds (table gates or open; match = text that occurs in exactly one item cell); kind verdict = a threshold decides PASS or FAIL, info = numbers for the owner to read.
